content.text:
Plugins are still supported in v4, but this docs set has no v3-style guide for writing them.

- **Loading plugins:** `src/docs/functions-and-directives.mdx`, "@plugin" section (~line 296). The `@plugin` directive loads a "legacy JavaScript-based plugin", for example `@plugin "@tailwindcss/typography";`. It takes a package name or a local path.
- **Mixing with CSS config:** the same file (~line 280) says `@config` and `@plugin` can be used together with `@theme`, `@utility` and similar CSS-driven features.
- **Not documented here:** the plugin authoring API (`addUtilities`, `matchUtilities`, and so on). I only searched for `@plugin`, so I can't rule out coverage under other terms. The docs also show no plugin-authoring page.

The graphify query returned only `package.json` nodes, so I used a direct grep of the `.mdx` files for the findings above.
